newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Lisbon air cargo traffic up 8.6 pct yr/yr in May.
newsitem.headline: Lisbon air cargo traffic up 8.6 pct yr/yr in May.

text.p: Cargo traffic at Lisbon airport in May rose 8.6 percent to 9,378.7 tonnes compared with the same month last year, according to figures released by Portugal's airports authority, ANA.
The figure brought to 43,656 tonnes the volume of cargo that transited Lisbon airport in the first five months of the year, up 11.0 percent from the same period in 1996.
Aircraft movements in May were 7,462, up 8.0 percent year-on-year.

May air freight totals for Oporto, the country's second busiest cargo airport, rose 6.5 percent to 2,246.9 tonnes. Volume was 12,260 tonnes in the first five months, up 22.2 percent compared with the same period last year.
